title: Jungle Temple

{{Infobox/Location |level = {{Skl|Mining 12}}
[[Heart of the Mountain]] Tier 4 |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Going Even Deeper|Going Even Deeper]]" |location=[[Jungle]] |mobs= *Kalhuiki Tribe Member *Sludge |resources= *Gemstone *Hard Stone *Sludge Juice *Jungle Heart *Pickonimbus 2000 }} The '''Jungle Temple''' is a [[Location]] in the {{Zone|Jungle}} of the {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}} where the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} can be obtained. {{ZoneText|A vast and sprawling underground civilization.|Temples and puzzles hide their treasures.|...and deep secrets.}} == Mechanics == The {{Zone|Jungle Temple}} main building houses the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}}, which is guarded by a series of 8 simple parkours with traps. {{green|2}} [[Crystal Hollows#Loot and Treasure Chests|Loot Chests]] also spawn at the end of the parkour; these chests have higher chances to contain a {{Item|Jungle Heart}}. Using a {{Item|Wishing Compass}} in the {{Zone|Jungle}} with a {{Item|Jungle Key}} in the inventory points towards the Jungle Temple. A {{Item|Jungle Key}} is required to enter the parkour and claim both [[Crystal Hollows#Loot and Treasure Chests|Loot Chests]] and the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} at the end of the parkour. The door to the Jungle Temple will open when players interact with either {{NPCSprite|Kalhuiki Door Guardian}} at the entrance using the {{Item|Jungle Key}}. If the player falls into or touch any body of {{Item|Lava}} during the run, the player will be teleported back to the entrance. Claiming the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} prevents the player from claiming it again as well as the surrounding [[Crystal Hollows#Loot and Treasure Chests|Loot Chests]], unless another {{Item|Jungle Key}} is given to the {{NPCSprite|Kalhuiki Door Guardian}}. Within the Jungle Temple area, the player's jump boost (from the {{PotN|Rabbit}} and {{PotN|Jump Boost}} effects) is removed, and any bonus {{Stat|spd}} is removed, only leaving base {{Stat|spd}}. == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Trivia == * The {{Item|Black Cat Pet}} used to be able to bypass the {{stat|spd}} cap of the Temple. **This has since been patched. * It is possible to enter the Temple without using a {{Item|Jungle Key}}, by mining at a precise location near the entrance stairs. However, if the parkour is completed without the usage of a temple key, the player cannot open any loot chests near the crystal and will be presented with this message when trying to obtain the crystal: "{{Rmt|&cYou haven't earned this Crystal! Come back when you have >:-)}}". * Sometimes, the {{PotN|Jump Boost}} potion effects are not properly removed upon entering the Jungle Temple area. This can be fixed by leaving and re-entering the area or disabling the Rabbit effect in the cookie buff menu. == Gallery == Amethyst Crystal Render.png|The [[Amethyst Crystal]] == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|ahn-0.12-r1|Added '''Jungle Temple'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.12|Added '''Jungle Temple'''.}} {{History|0.19.1|Fixed the '''Jungle Temple''' door not closing after using an {{Item|Ascension Rope}}.}} {{History|2023/Aug 15|Fixed being able to use {{AN|Sinrecall Transmission}} in the '''Jungle Temple'''.}} {{History|Unknown|The {{Item|Aspect of the End}} and {{Item|Aspect of the Void}}'s {{AN|Instant Transmission}} and {{AN|Ether Transmission}} abilities now work in the '''Jungle Temple'''.}} {{History|2024/February 6|Fixed being able to use {{AN|Instant Transmission}} and {{AN|Ether Transmission}} in the '''Jungle Temple'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Crystal Hollows}} {{Nav/Locations}}
